source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 506 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-506.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 506 was established by Ordinance No. 23579, passed by the Dallas City Council on June 24, 1998. Ordinance No. 23579 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 23579; 26042)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-506.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 506 is established on property generally located along the south line of Forest Lane, beginning at its intersection with the southeast line of the former H.&T.C. Railroad right-of-way. The size of PD 506 is approximately 5.577 acres. (Ord. Nos. 23579; 26042)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-506.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a nonresidential zoning district. (Ord. Nos. 23579; 26042)

sections.title: Development And Landscape Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-506.104. DEVELOPMENT AND LANDSCAPE PLAN.

Development and use of the Property must comply with the development and landscape plan (Exhibit 506A). In the event of a conflict between the provisions of this article and the development and landscape plan, the provisions of this article control. (Ord. Nos. 23579; 26042)

sections.title: Main Use Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-506.105. MAIN USE PERMITTED.

The only use permitted by this PD is a transit passenger station or transfer center. (Ord. Nos. 23579; 26042)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-506.106. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(a) Front, side, and rear yards. Front, side, and rear yards for the PD are per the development and landscape plan.

(b) Floor area. Maximum floor area is 25,000 square feet.

(c) Height. Maximum structure height is 48 feet. A transit passenger station or transfer center is exempt from the residential proximity slope.

(d) Lot coverage. Maximum lot coverage is 10 percent.

(e) Stories. Maximum number of stories above grade is two. (Ord. Nos. 23579; 26042)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-506.107. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

Required off-street parking and loading must be provided as shown on the development and landscape plan. (Ord. Nos. 23579; 26042)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-506.108. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. Nos. 23579; 26042)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-506.109. LANDSCAPING.

Landscaping must comply with the development and landscape plan, and be installed in accordance with Article X. Plant material must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. Tree mitigation requirements must be met as outlined in Article X. (Ord. Nos. 23579; 26042)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-506.110. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts contained in Article VII. (Ord. Nos. 23579; 26042)

sections.title: Access
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-506.111. ACCESS.

Ingress and egress must be provided as shown on the development and landscape plan. Median improvements on Forest Lane, as shown on the development and landscape plan, must be completed prior to the issuance of a certificate of occupancy. (Ord. Nos. 23579; 26042)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-506.112. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The entire Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(b) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 23579; 26042)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-506.113. PAVING.

All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 23579; 26042)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-506.114. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 23579; 26042)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-506.115. ZONING MAP.

PD 506 is located on Zoning Map No. D-8. (Ord. Nos. 23579; 26042)
